propositions: DC Lucene index eventual consistency (lag up to 2991s) causes recover_pending's keyless-branch JQL search to miss unindexed issues and unbind prematurely
Unbinding at site 1 (recover_pending) enables create_one's dedup search at site 2 to also miss the same unindexed issue, resulting in a duplicate Jira issue
The duplicate occurs even if recover_pending leaves the entry pending, because get_jira_key returns None for keyless-pending entries and the create gate does not consult is_pending

Fix requires both: (a) defer unbind at site 1 until search_miss_count>=3 AND entry older than grace window, and (b) gate create at site 2 to defer (not drop) while keyless-pending binding is within grace window

Bare MagicMock test doubles in test_write_ahead_recovery.py answered new is_keyless_pending_within_grace with truthy Mock instead of False, causing creates to defer spuriously and masking test defects
